verdict.rationale: v0's built-in deployment targets Vercel only (one-click deploy to Vercel-powered infrastructure). Code portability is documented: you can connect to GitHub and push code to your own repository, and the API offers export for backup and migration. That makes deploying to another host possible, but only through extra tooling the user sets up outside v0. Missing for 10: any documented path for deploying to non-Vercel or self-managed infrastructure, guidance on running the generated app outside Vercel, and hands-on reports of hosting v0 apps elsewhere.
